newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - Angping says Selecta a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Angping says Selecta a buy.

text.p: Angping Securities on Thursday recommended a buy on ice cream maker Selecta Dairy Products Inc due to a likely improvement in sales.
Angping said Selecta's move to tie up with local restaurants and hotels will help expand its market share, which currently stands at 39 percent nationwide.

"Selecta has high growth prospects in the coming years. One basic gauge for this is the surging sales of its free delivery service ... The company also has a foothold in the booming restaurant business," Angping said.
It added that the declining costs of sugar and milk will benefit the company next year.
Selecta was unchanged at 2.18 pesos in early trade.
